title: A secret list
subtitle: competitive daily consumption
blurb: One row per entry per day. Whoever's layer sits on top of the strip is winning.
notes: One a day, and the day appears when it arrives.
The list starts on 21 August 2026 and runs to whatever today is on the device you are reading it on. There is no end date and nothing to pre-generate: tomorrow's row exists tomorrow.
Tick the day you had one. Catching up to a row marks every day before it, which is a strong claim, so use it deliberately.
Everyone who knows the password is in the same group.

Getting in signs you into REDACTED automatically, so every layer on the strip is someone else who typed it. Furthest along sits on top. No finish date, so nobody is behind — this is a race with no finish line, which is the correct shape for it.

The list is named in the switcher and marked Secret, so people know it exists; the password is what opens it. That is the whole of what it does. The site is static files with no server, so the rows and this note are readable by anyone who fetches the JSON directly. Do not put anything here you would mind being found.
